The HSQC data confirm the connectivity between protons and carbons, supporting the presence of an aromatic ring and an aliphatic chain.

Given this information, the structure likely includes a phenyl group and an aliphatic chain with a chiral center (indicated by the dd peak at δ 4.62 in 1H NMR).
